description: §42.2.3 — the soft-deprecated `given name :>` present-case arm of a `match` over a `string | not` value surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED (Info; exactly 1), is accepted (no E- code: the `not` arm plus the `given` arm are exhaustive), and RUNS: the present case takes the `given` arm (`hello ada`), the §63.5 identity with `else :>`. The legacy spelling is the PURPOSE of this case; it is not migrated.
rationale: §42.2.3 (S462) — the `given x :>` match arm is SOFT-DEPRECATED (canonical: `else :>` after the `not :>` arm) and surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED; §63.5 — the W-code is a conformance-required code during the window. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go".
